extra.reason: Live re-verified post-deploy on rpi-zero: make ship-check-nobelt now talks HTTPS to the self-signed server (all L0/L2-read/L3 PASS, VERDICT: READY TO SHIP). The HTTPS probe rewrite (c93ce66) is the actual fix; verification was just blocked on Pi availability.

Two-part bug, both fixed: (1) tap during SPEAKING left userActivated armed (interrupt() path didn't deactivate); (2) server-side 'interrupted' signal arriving in response to silent context pushes (incline bumps) bounced voiceState back to LISTENING via the ungated onInterrupted callback, lighting the mic icon as 'active' even though audio was correctly dropped. Fix: SPEAKING toggle branch mirrors LISTENING (clear userActivated, flush, IDLE); onInterrupted now gated on userActivated; line 362 (mic perm fail) and line 379 (teardownConnection) also clear userActivated as belt-and-suspenders cleanup. Verified live on tablet (SM-X115): 5 post-deactivation server INTERRUPTED signals captured, each shows onInterrupted with voiceState=IDLE, state held.
